name: Guardian: The Lonely and Great God
description: In his quest for a bride to break his immortal curse, a 939-year-old guardian of souls meets a grim reaper and a sprightly student with a tragic past.

videos.title: Every Moment of It Shined
videos.overview: This is a recap of the past 13 episodes. Tune in to watch the most popular scenes and a deep analysis of the main characters. This special is brought to you by Mr. Kim, the late Chairman Yu’s secretary.

videos.title: The Summoning: Part 1
videos.overview: This special episode provides lots of special clips that will satisfy the viewers who missed the show dearly ever since Goblin has ended. From behind-the-scene footage to summaries of the beautiful love story of each couple, the show will surely make the Goblin fans happy.

videos.title: The Summoning: Part 2
videos.overview: Continuing from the Part 1, Part 2 also provides a lot of special clips that will satisfy the viewers who missed the show dearly ever since Goblin has ended. Part 2 reveals many behind scenes containing ad-libs of the actors, secrets of the character’s makeup and so on. Part 2 will reveal what the viewers have been wondering as they watched Goblin.

videos.title: What Kind of a Guardian Are You?
videos.overview: After Kim Shin is sentenced to death for treason, he is reborn and wanders the earth in search of the bride who can release him from his immortality.

videos.title: I'll Become Your Bride in 200 Years
videos.overview: Eun-tak follows Shin and suddenly finds herself transported to Quebec. Realizing she is in a foreign country, she is convinced of Shin's true nature.

videos.title: I See the Sword
videos.overview: Shin and a Grim Reaper rescue Eun-tak after she is kidnapped by loan sharks. Shin has Deok-hwa investigate Eun-tak's aunt who got her into trouble.

videos.title: I Won't Leave You
videos.overview: Shaken when Eun-tak tells him that she could see the sword all along, Shin still wants to live. The Reaper offers to bring her to the afterlife.

videos.title: I Have to End My Life
videos.overview: Sunny and the Reaper meet again and go to a café. She grows impatient and tries to have a conversation, but when she asks his name he abruptly leaves.

videos.title: Tomorrow
videos.overview: Shin sees Eun-tak in the future and asks her to pull out the sword. But Eun-tak doesn't understand the consequences that would bring.

videos.title: I Think It's Your Face
videos.overview: When Eun-tak returns home after her test, Shin, Deok-hwa and the Reaper greet her with a cake. She and Shin head out to the movies.

videos.title: You Gave Her That Fate
videos.overview: Eun-tak finally takes hold of the sword but Shin pushes her away. She is happy to know that she is the bride, but he doesn't seem to share her joy.

videos.title: He'll Vanish Forever From This World to Another
videos.overview: After hearing the truth of the sword from the Reaper, Eun-tak runs away from Shin. He looks everywhere he can think of but she is nowhere to be found.

videos.title: Is She Really Your Sister?
videos.overview: After the Reaper forgets that he erased Sunny's memory and makes a slip of the tongue, she demands to know who he is and why he knows her real name.

videos.title: The Deity Is So Cruel to You and Me
videos.overview: Shin learns from the Reaper that Sunny is the reincarnation of his sister. They go to the chicken shop, but the incredulous Sunny tells them to leave.

videos.title: Forget About Me
videos.overview: Eun-tak remembers the Reaper's words when she sees a creepy ghost while at work. Shin and the Reaper realize that Deok-hwa is not who he seems.

videos.title: Protect Her
videos.overview: The Reaper receives a punishment from the underworld authorities for revealing his identity and using his special powers for his own purposes.

videos.title: Whom Have I Forgotten?
videos.overview: Shin pulls out the sword to protect Eun-tak from Park Joong-heon. He then departs for a desolate place where he struggles against loneliness.

videos.title: Will You Be My Bride?
videos.overview: Eun-tak is suspicious when Shin suddenly appears on the street in Canada, but he reminds her of her promise to treat him to a meal.

videos.title: Goodbye and See You Again
videos.overview: Shin proposes to Eun-tak amid the falling cherry blossoms. On a whim he wants to have the wedding in a few days, so they jump right into preparations.
